name: Nanaimo Back to School 2022

venue.name: Beban Park, Nanaimo, BC
venue.details: This event will be held in the Auditorium.

information: We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Nanaimo, B.C., for the Nanaimo Back to School 2022 cubing competition. It's been a little while since we've seen cubing competitions in B.C., and we're thrilled to be one of the teams bringing cubers back together again to compete, connect, and have fun! Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed. We look forward to a full house of 65 competitors! Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule - for events in the afternoon (4x4x4 and onwards), **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.
